answer: Sybil resistance follows from computing reputation over the EigenTrust matrix with reciprocity-weighted transitivity, then applying exponential temporal decay with a fixed half-life. Influence therefore requires sustained honest service, not a brief burst of endorsements. Freshly spawned Sybil identities have little trusted incoming mass and near-zero eigenvector centrality, so multiplying accounts or echoing claims across an ocean of marble-like profiles on one ridge cannot make them pass consensus.
